ShortDescription.Value: American-style highway toll plazas: booths, canopy and slowing traffic that pays a toll.

Publish.LongDescription:
Toll Plaza adds American-style highway toll plazas to Cities: Skylines II. Pick a plaza with 2 to 6 booths from the Road Services menu and drop it on a highway. Vehicles slow through the booths and pay a toll that goes straight to the city treasury, with a Toll Plazas line in the budget screen.
- Cash and E-Toll lanes, with closable booths and animated gate arms - Live roof, toll-rate and speed signs that follow your settings - A control panel with city totals (this month, last month, all time) and a plaza panel for per-plaza rates - An Options page for plaza prices and the rates a new city starts with, plus buttons to reset a city's toll data - Toll data is stored outside the save file and written crash-safe
Joining a plaza to a one-way road that runs the wrong way flips that road to match, when it ends loose. If it reaches a junction, the placement preview turns red and you'll need to flip that road yourself first.

ChangeLog.Value: 0.1.0 - First release. Toll plazas with 2 to 6 booths and a canopy; vehicles slow down and pay a toll that goes to the city treasury. Control panel with city totals (this month, last month, all time), plaza info panel with per-plaza rates, live toll and speed signs, animated gate arms, cash and E-Toll lanes, closable booths. Options page for plaza prices and starting toll rates, with buttons to reset a city's toll data. Toll data is kept outside the save file and written crash-safe.
